sizes.kind: bond: fund the bond output (1 in, bond + change)
bond: spend through the CLTV leaf (tweak form, 1 leaf)
bond: spend through the CLTV leaf (leaf form, 2 leaves)
tick genesis: fund T_0 (1 in, T_0 + change)
tick advance2: T_n to T_n+1 (agent, script path, depth 1)
tick advance3: T_n to T_n+1 (agent + 3 guardians, depth 3)
veto: T_n to halt output (one guardian, plain v2, depth 4)
renew: halt output to T_n+1 (3 guardians, single-leaf tree)
renew: T_n to T_n+1 (3 guardians, depth 3)
veto: T_n to one P2TR output (one guardian, plain v2, depth 3)
co-sign: recovery leaf (2 of 3 guardians, CHECKSIGADD)
anchor: log root in the output's tweak (1 in, 1 out)
anchor: log root in OP_RETURN (1 in, change + OP_RETURN)
key-path spend, 1 in 1 out (the model's seal transaction shape)
veto: v3 TRUC, T_n to halt + zero-value P2A, zero fee
veto child: v3, spends the P2A + one fee input (CPFP)
sizes.note: pays for parent and child at twice the model fee rate

proof_bytes.note: regtest blocks hold a few transactions, so Merkle branches here are 1 or 2 hashes deep
